title: Kuzey Odanın Canavarları
author: Barış Selim Uzun
description: In this haunting and immersive novel, the protagonist, Eşref Teba, navigates a world both intimate and absurdly bureaucratic, where personal grief, societal surveillance, and hidden desires intertwine. Following the death of his wife Melike, Eşref is forced to confront his tangled past, the labyrinthine procedures of official “process officers,” and the ethical and emotional weight of secrets that govern both public and private life.
